description: Create a test call so you can hear an After Hours answering line before anything is set up: it returns a shared test phone number and a 4-digit code (valid 24 hours, up to 5 calls). Calling the number and keying the code reaches a phone assistant answering as the business you describe, and hear_url plays the same assistant in a browser. Nothing is booked, sent or charged on a test line, and it is not a real line: for one on the business's own number use set_up_answering_line. business_name and trade are required; trade sets what the assistant knows to ask, and area, hours, services and timezone shape what it says. Needs a signed-in account (any permissions); limited to 3 test lines a day per account, and rate limited. Returns { sandbox, test_number, test_number_e164, test_code, hear_url, expires_at, calls_allowed, how }.

business_name.description: The name the receptionist answers as, e.g. "Alvarez Plumbing".

hours.description: Opening hours in words, e.g. "Mon-Fri 8 AM to 5 PM, closed weekends".

trade.description: The kind of business; it sets what the receptionist knows to ask.

name: try_answering_line
title: Try an answering line free: a test number and code
